URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/claim-gas-and-solana-minimum

### How do the weekly airdrops work?

Warzone Airdrops are a weekly reward for active traders and creators who are not the biggest wallets. Each chain runs its own airdrop with its own pot, in that chain's coin. The weekly window closes on Monday at 00:00 UTC. Winners are picked from the closed week and published shortly after. The pot is split over the winners, so a bigger pot means more winners. The Airdrops tab shows the running week, the current pool, a preview of who is eligible and past winners. The preview is an estimate, and the final list is made at the drop.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/weekly-airdrops-explained

### Am I eligible for the weekly airdrop?

Two groups can qualify in a weekly window: traders with real buying and selling, and creators whose coins attract real buyers. Traders need a minimum volume, a minimum number of trades and activity on more than one day in the week. A creator's own buys do not count toward their coin. Wallets flagged by security checks are left out. Very large activity is capped, so the pot spreads over more people. The limits are the same in US dollars on every chain. The exact numbers are not published.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/airdrop-eligibility

### Can I win the airdrop every week? What happens to unclaimed airdrops?

A wallet that won sits out for 14 days before it can win again. Airdrop wins can be claimed for 60 days. After that, unclaimed drops go back into the pot and help a later week.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/airdrop-cooldown-and-return

### Where does the airdrop pot come from?

Airdrops are funded from the trade fee. When a trader has no recruiter, the recruiter and squad slices of that trade's fee go to the airdrop pot instead. That is 15% of the 2% fee on those trades. The pot therefore depends on how many traders have no recruiter, so it changes from week to week.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/where-airdrop-money-comes-from

### How do I claim creator fees from my coin?

Open the Command Center, then Rewards and claims. If you launched coins, a Creator fees card lists each coin with the amount you can claim. After graduation, pool fees from the locked liquidity are collected from My coins. Open the coin and use the claim button on its row. If the pool is not ready or nothing is waiting, the row says so. Your share depends on the launch and the chain, so check the fee page for the current split.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/creator-fee-claims

### Where do I claim squad and recruiter rewards?

Squad rewards are on the Squad Rewards row of Rewards and claims. The row shows when you are in a squad or have a squad reward. Recruiter earnings are in a separate Recruiter Rewards card. Sign once with your recruiter wallet to view and claim.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/squad-and-recruiter-rewards-claims

### I cannot see my reward. What should I check?

Rewards and claims shows one chain and one wallet at a time. Most missing rewards are on another chain or another wallet. If the amount is still missing, the round may not have closed or the result may not be published yet. Weekly rewards close on Monday 00:00 UTC. Anti-abuse checks can also exclude activity from a reward. Product questions go to Discord support, and impersonation or phishing goes to Report Abuse. 1. Connect the wallet that earned the reward. 2. Switch the chain at the top of the tab. 3. Check the round has closed and results are published. 4. Ask in Discord support with your wallet address and the round.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/reward-missing-or-wrong-wallet

### When are weekly rewards calculated and published?

The standard weekly close is Monday at 00:00 UTC. After that, results for the completed window are checked and published. Eligible reward rows then appear in Rewards and claims, and you claim them with your wallet. Monthly leagues close on the 1st of the month at 00:00 UTC.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/reward-timing-weekly-close

## Importing coins

### What is an imported coin?

An imported coin is a memecoin that launched somewhere else and was brought to MemeWarzone. It gets the same coin page as a coin launched here, with chart, Buy and Sell panel, posts and holders. The difference is underneath. An imported coin trades in its own DEX pool, not on a MemeWarzone bonding curve. Its name and ticker come from the token and cannot be changed.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/what-are-imported-coins

### Which coins can I import?

A coin can be imported when all of these are true: It is on BNB Chain, Solana or Robinhood Chain. It has finished its bonding phase on the platform where it launched. A coin still bonding on Pump.fun, Four.meme or a similar launchpad is refused. Come back after it graduates. It trades in a DEX pool with real liquidity. It passes the safety checks.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/which-coins-can-be-imported

### How do I import a coin?

Anyone can import a coin. Your wallet signs the import request, but it does not need to hold or own the token. The signature is not a transaction and costs nothing. 1. Open Import memecoin in the menu. You can also start from Command Center, My coins, Import memecoin. 2. Choose the chain: BNB, Solana or Robinhood. 3. Connect a wallet on that chain. 4. Paste the coin's contract address. On Solana this is the mint address. 5. Press IMPORT MEMECOIN and sign the message in your wallet. MemeWarzone looks up the token, checks its market and runs the safety scan. When that passes you land on the coin's new page.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/how-to-import-a-coin

### How do I import a Pump.fun coin?

Wait until the coin has graduated on Pump.fun. A coin that is still bonding is refused. Then follow the normal import steps on the Solana chain and paste the coin's mint address. If you want to claim the coin as its owner, you will need the wallet Pump.fun recorded as the creator. Pump.fun may have created a separate wallet for you when you signed up, which can differ from the Phantom or Solflare wallet you normally use. The import page has a Got a Pump.fun token? guide with the official export and import steps.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/import-a-pumpfun-coin

### Do I need to own or hold a coin to import it, and does it cost anything?

No on both. Any wallet can import a coin, and it does not need to hold the token. Importing costs nothing because it is a signature and not a transaction. Importing does not make you the owner. The real owner claims the coin separately, and trading does not wait for that claim.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/do-i-need-to-own-the-token-to-import

### Why was my import refused?

An import is refused when the scan finds a problem that nobody can override. The coin is also refused while it is still bonding. The address is not a token on the chain you chose. Selling fails (a honeypot). The token cannot be transferred, or transfers are paused. The transfer tax is above 10%. The coin is still bonding on its original launchpad.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/why-was-my-import-refused

### My import is waiting for review. What does that mean?

Some findings do not refuse an import but send it to review, for example when the safety scan could not finish or the market data is unclear. The page exists, but the coin is not listed until the review is done. If the lookup was only busy, nothing is rejected: press IMPORT again.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/import-sent-to-review

### How do I prove I own an imported coin?

An imported coin starts unclaimed, and trading does not wait for the claim. If you run the project, open the coin page and press CLAIM MEMECOIN. The popup lists the ways you can prove ownership. Which ones you see depends on the chain and the token. The options appear in this order: the owner wallet, the project's X account, and last, manual review. Use the first one that works for you. 1. Owner wallet: on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain connect the wallet that is the token contract's current owner. On Solana connect the recorded project authority wallet. 2. Project X account: if the token lists an official X account, press VERIFY WITH X and sign in to that exact account. 3. Manual review: press REQUEST MANUAL REVIEW and give an X account where the team can reach you. The team checks the claim and contacts you. Until the claim is verified the coin shows Ownership pending.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/claim-an-imported-coin

### The claim popup does not offer the owner wallet option. Why?

On BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain the owner wallet option reads the token contract's current owner. If the contract exposes no active owner, for example because ownership was renounced, the option is not available. Use the project's official X account if the token lists one, or request manual review. If you connect a wallet that is not the owner, the owner option shows the recorded owner but cannot be used.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/claim-popup-has-no-owner-wallet-option

### Verify with X says I used the wrong account. What now?

The claim only works with the exact X account attached to the token. Signing in with a different account fails and the popup tells you that was not the correct account. Sign in with the project's X account, verify the owner wallet instead, or request manual review.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/wrong-x-account-when-claiming

### What happens to the creator's half of the fee if nobody has claimed the coin?

The creator's 0.5% builds up while the coin is unclaimed. It is held for 90 days per trade. Claim the coin within that time to collect it. Whatever is still unclaimed after 90 days goes to MemeWarzone.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/unclaimed-creator-share-90-days

### Why does my coin already have a MemeWarzone page?

If a coin earned creator fees through the swap box on a website but had no page here, MemeWarzone imports it itself, through the same checks as a user import. The creator then finds the coin with a Creator earned notice and a Claim button. A coin that is refused, for example because it is still bonding, is retried about every 6 hours.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/creator-earned-claim-it-auto-import

### Where do imported coins trade?

In the coin's own DEX pool, through the same Buy and Sell panel as other coins. The coin page shows a Trading on line, and the button names the DEX, for example Buy on Jupiter. Trading is switched off on a coin when the safety scan reports a honeypot or a blocked transfer. Solana: Jupiter, which routes through the coin's pools. BNB Chain: PancakeSwap pools. Robinhood Chain: Uniswap.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/where-do-imported-coins-trade

### Can imported coins battle and get UpVotes?

Yes. Imported coins can battle in the Warzone and have their own UpVotes. Imported and graduated coins are featured in the Warzone overview. Once the coin is claimed, the owner can challenge other coins. Imported coins also appear in Search, in the Imported coins panel on Coins, and in the War Room under the Imported tab.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/imported-coins-battles-and-upvotes

### What can I do after I claim an imported coin?

Connect the owner wallet and press EDIT on the coin page to change the description, website, X and Telegram links, and upload the project image. Open Edit page from Command Center, My coins, for tags, links, a pinned post, the Story text and Story images. You can also post updates as the coin, turn auto updates (launch, graduation and battle results) on or off, and challenge other coins to battles. The name and ticker cannot be changed, and every edit is signed by your wallet.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/what-can-the-owner-do-after-claiming

### Someone else claimed my imported coin. What can I do?

Claims have to be proven with the token's owner wallet, the project's X account, or manual review by the team, so a claim made without one of these does not go through. If you believe someone claimed your coin falsely, report it with Report Abuse in the Command Center under Support and safety, and include the coin address and what proves you are the owner.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/someone-else-claimed-my-coin

## Recruiters and squads

### What is a MemeWarzone recruiter?

A recruiter brings creators and traders to MemeWarzone with a personal code and link. The wallets that join through that link form the recruiter's squad. Recruiters earn a share of the trade fee from the wallets they brought in. They do not own those users and they do not change the rules for rewards, claims or eligibility.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/what-is-a-recruiter

### How do I become a recruiter?

Anyone with a BNB Chain, Solana or Robinhood Chain wallet can sign up. The recruiter account is created as active when you submit the signed form. You can also start from the Recruiter tab in the Command Center. A wallet can be a recruiter only once, and a code can be used only once. 1. Open the recruiter signup page and connect your wallet. 2. Choose a recruiter code: lowercase letters, numbers, dashes or underscores. The page tells you if it is taken. 3. Enter a display name, an email and a short pitch about your audience. Telegram, Discord and X handles are optional. 4. Accept the recruiter terms and sign the signup message in your wallet.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/become-a-recruiter

### What is my referral link and how do I change my code?

Your referral link ends in /r/ followed by your code, for example /r/yourcode. The Recruiter tab in the Command Center shows your referral link and a home link, each with a copy button, plus Share on X. To change your code, open the Recruiter tab, press Sign in to manage with the recruiter wallet, type the new code and press Save code. A code that another recruiter already has cannot be used.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/recruiter-referral-link

### How does a wallet get linked to a recruiter?

When someone opens a referral link, the app remembers the recruiter's code for a limited time. The person can connect a wallet afterwards. On connect, and after the wallet signs in, the wallet is linked to that recruiter and joins the squad. A new member chooses whether they join as a creator, a trader or both. A wallet is linked to one recruiter at a time. A wallet that already has a recruiter keeps it, and an opened link for another recruiter does not replace it.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/how-recruiter-attribution-works

### Can I change my recruiter after I joined? What is the lock?

The link is meant to stay in place so reward routing is auditable and nobody can hop between codes. Once a wallet has activity on MemeWarzone, its link is locked. If you opened the wrong link, fix it before you trade, create or take part in anything. After the lock, a different link will not replace your recruiter.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/recruiter-link-lock

### How much does a recruiter earn?

A recruiter earns 12.5% of the trade fee paid by wallets they brought in. The trade fee is 2%, so that is 0.25% of each trade. A recruiter also earns 15% of the graduation fee of coins those wallets create, which is 0.30% of the raise. Earnings are paid in the chain's own coin and claimed in the Command Center under Rewards and claims. They depend on the real trading of your linked wallets, so they can be zero.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/recruiter-earnings

### What are OG recruiters?

OG recruiters are an early recruiter class. They earn 15% of the trade fee (0.30% of each trade) and 17.5% of the graduation fee (0.35%). The extra comes out of MemeWarzone's share, not from the traders. OG status is shown on the recruiter's public page.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/og-recruiters

### What is a squad?

A squad is the group of wallets linked to one recruiter. If you joined through a recruiter's link, you are in that recruiter's squad. The Squad tab in the Command Center appears only when your wallet is in a squad. The tab shows the squad status, the members, how many members are eligible and the pending pool. Public squad standings are on the Squads page.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/what-is-a-squad

### How does the squad pool work?

The squad pool is 2.5% of the 2% trade fee. It is shared every week by eligible members, based on their contribution. It is not an equal split, and it is not a reward for showing up once. Squad rewards are claimed in Rewards and claims, on the Squad Rewards row. The pool does not guarantee the same result for every member.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/squad-pool-explained

### Why am I not eligible for squad rewards?

Being a member is not enough. Your own activity has to qualify under the weekly rules, and fair-play checks apply before rewards are shown. The Eligible tile on the Squad tab shows how many members qualify. A wallet that is detached from the squad or flagged under the fair-play rules can lose eligibility for that week.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/why-not-eligible-squad-rewards

### Can I leave a squad?

There is no leave button in the app. A squad link is tied to the recruiter that brought the wallet in, and it locks once the wallet has activity. If you have a problem with your link, ask in Discord support.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/leave-or-switch-squad

### Are there fair-play checks on recruiters and squads?

Yes. Fair-play checks apply to recruiters and squads, and anti-abuse checks can affect eligibility, ranking, winner selection and claim status. Activity that looks like self trading, wash trading, circular activity or linked wallet farming can be excluded. Joins from one network are limited, only the wallet's owner can join, and a recruiter's own wallets cannot be linked to their own code. A recruiter can be suspended for scripted or fake squads. The exact triggers are not published.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/squad-join-limits-fair-play

### What does the recruiter dashboard show?

The Recruiter tab in the Command Center shows tiles for linked wallets, creators, traders, your code and your status. After you press Sign in to manage and sign with the recruiter wallet, it also lists recent referrals with their role and join date. You can copy your links, share on X, upload a squad image (PNG, JPG or WebP) for your public squad page and open your public recruiter page. Recruiter rewards are claimed in Rewards and claims.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/recruiter-dashboard

### Where are the recruiter and squad leaderboards?

The recruiter leaderboard is at /recruiters. It compares recruiters by network growth, activity, earnings and performance score, sorted by total earned and then by linked wallets. The squad leaderboard is at /squads. It shows how squads rank this week, the estimated share of the squad pool for each squad and how members rank by contribution. Estimates are not payouts.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/recruiter-and-squad-leaderboards

### Is there a prize for the best recruiters?

Yes. The Recruiter League is a weekly and monthly prize league on every chain, paid from the league fee. It is one all-chains ranking, and a paid place needs referred trading in the current round. Prizes go to your recruiter wallet on each chain. Prizes are not guaranteed and are claimed in Rewards and claims.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/recruiter-league-prizes

## UpVotes and promotion

### What is an UpVote?

An UpVote is a paid push for a coin's visibility. It helps the coin rank higher on Coins, in Featured and Trending, and on the Warzone pages. It does not buy the coin and it gives you no tokens. It is not a safety label, a quality mark or an endorsement by MemeWarzone. It only shows that somebody paid to push the coin. Promotion is usually hidden. UpVotes make it visible.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/what-is-an-upvote

### How do I UpVote a coin?

You need a connected wallet on the coin's chain. An UpVote is a payment, so your wallet asks you to confirm a transaction. 1. Press UpVote on a coin card on Coins, on a Featured card or on the coin page. 2. Read the popup. It shows the price, fixed at 3 dollars and paid in the chain's own coin. 3. Confirm the payment in your wallet. One transaction is one vote.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/how-to-upvote-a-coin

### How much is an UpVote and is there a limit?

An UpVote costs 3 dollars on every chain, paid in BNB, SOL or ETH. The popup converts the 3 dollars at the current price. The fee goes to MemeWarzone. A cooldown and daily limits apply to keep UpVotes fair. The popup tells you when you hit one.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/upvote-price-and-limits

### Does an UpVote mean a coin is safe?

No. An UpVote does not certify a coin, remove risk or make other traders follow. Money spent on visibility is only visibility. Check the coin yourself: the official links, the holders and the wallet request. Be careful with links that offer to UpVote for you.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/upvotes-and-safety

### What is the Featured list, and what is the Warzone Featured rail?

Coins that are still on their bonding curve are ranked in the launchpad Featured list by UpVotes over a window you can pick: the last 24 hours, 7 days or all time. Graduated and imported coins have their own UpVotes, and they are featured in the Warzone overview. Each chain has its own list, because the Coins pages show one chain at a time.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/featured-lists-explained

### How do I advertise my project on MemeWarzone?

You can apply for a paid ad spot. There are two: a banner tile in the row at the top of Home (up to 6 sponsors at once) and a Sponsored card in the Featured row on Coins. Each spot has its own packages and prices. Use the Your ad here tile on Home, Advertise here in the Featured row, or the application page. A sponsored spot is paid visibility, not an endorsement. 1. Open the application and fill in your project name, contact, website, short bio and a creative image. 2. Pick a package and your preferred dates. 3. Send it. The team reviews your project and creative. 4. After approval you get payment details. The spot goes live after payment.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/apply-for-a-sponsorship

### What happens after I apply for a sponsorship?

Applying starts a review. It does not book the spot, and no payment is due yet. The team checks the project and the creative, confirms the dates and then sends payment details. Make sure the bio, image and dates are final before you send the form. Your draft is saved in your browser until you submit. Only pay what the team confirms. Nobody from MemeWarzone asks for payment in a direct message.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/after-sponsorship-application

### What is a Story page?

A Story is a full-screen page for one coin, in the style of social stories. It has chapters written by the creator and an automatic chronicle built from real data. The creator cannot edit the chronicle. A launched coin can have up to 10 chapters and an imported coin up to 8. Every Story has a share link. When you post that link on X, it shows a preview card with the coin's picture.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/story-pages

### How do I share a coin so people land on the right page?

Share the MemeWarzone coin page link. It carries the chain, so the person lands on the right coin. If you share a bare address, say which chain it is on. A Story share link gives X a preview card. In posts on MemeWarzone, paste the contract address and it turns into a coin card with a Buy button. Each post also has a Share menu with Copy link and Share on X.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/share-a-coin-link

### How do drafts, the Prepare page and Push Live help promote a launch?

A draft can have a public Prepare page. People can read it, follow it and comment before trading opens. Use that time to settle your links, logo, message and launch time. Push Live is the last step. It turns a prepared draft into a live launch. If the launch is scheduled, trading can open up to 30 days later. Do not push live while links or timing are still changing.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/prepare-page-and-push-live

### Can I put a buy and sell box on my own website?

Yes, for Solana coins. The swap box lets visitors buy and sell from your site with their own wallet. You paste a few lines of code into a Custom HTML block. It works for coins launched on MemeWarzone while they are on the curve and for imported coins. Imported coin swaps pay 1%, of which 0.5% goes to the coin's creator. A launched coin pays the normal fees. The box shows the fee before anyone confirms.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/swap-box-for-your-website

### Can I stream live on my MemeWarzone profile?

Live streams from Kick can show on a profile, with a flashing red LIVE tab after Posts while the channel is live. At the moment only one partner profile has this. There is no setting yet for other users to add their own stream. The stream plays in Kick's own player, so Kick sets cookies when it loads. MemeWarzone asks for cookie consent first. If you decline, the stream stays off and you can watch on kick.com instead.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/kick-live-streams

### How can a creator keep holders informed?

The owner of a coin can post updates as the coin from the Posts tab of its coin page. An update is up to 280 characters with up to 4 images. It shows the coin's logo and a Creator update label. Tick Also in the home feed to share it more widely. The coin page also posts automatic updates for the launch, graduation and battles. Owners can turn those off on the edit page. Battles, UpVotes and league pushes are the other ways to get attention.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/post-updates-as-your-coin

### What is the difference between an UpVote and a Boost?

An UpVote is a 3 dollar push for a coin's visibility in lists and the Crowd Favorite league. A Boost is a 1 dollar vote inside a battle. It adds 1 point for the coin you back in that battle. A wallet can Boost twice per battle, and Boosts close when the last 20% of the battle starts. UpVotes have a cooldown and daily limits.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/upvote-vs-boost

## Profiles and the feed

### How do I set up my profile?

Every wallet has one public profile. Open Command Center, then Edit profile, or press Edit on your own profile. You can set a picture, a banner, a display name, an @username, a bio of up to 280 characters, and links to your website, X and Telegram. Press Save profile. Your wallet signs a message to prove it is you. This is not a transaction and costs no fee. Without a picture, your profile shows the default green operative.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/set-up-your-profile

### How do usernames work?

Your @username is how people tag you in posts. It has 3 to 20 characters: letters, numbers and underscore. It is unique and case does not matter, so Trader and trader are the same name. Some names, such as admin, support and memewarzone, are reserved. You can change it once every 30 days. Setting or changing it asks for a wallet signature, with no fee. Without a username nobody can tag you. Your profile also opens at /profile/yourname.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/username-rules

### Do I need a separate profile for each chain?

No. A profile belongs to a wallet, and its picture, name, @username and bio show on every chain. An EVM wallet address is the same on BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain, so one profile covers both. A Solana wallet has its own address and its own profile. Social features work across chains. You can follow any coin or wallet on any chain. Only buying and selling depends on the chain you picked.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/one-profile-on-every-chain

### How do I write a post and add images?

Use the composer at the top of Home or on your own profile. A post can be up to 1,000 characters. The feed shows the first 280 characters with a Read more link. You can add up to 4 images, each PNG, JPG or WebP up to 5 MB. Paste a coin's contract address and it turns into a coin card with the price and a Buy button. Type @ and the first letters of a name to tag someone who has a username. 1. Connect your wallet. 2. Type your post in the composer. Use the image button to add up to 4 images. 3. Press Post. The first time, your wallet asks for one free signature.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/write-a-post

### What are reposts, quote posts and rockets?

A rocket is your like. Tap it again to take it back. Repost puts a post in your followers' feeds and on your profile. Quote post lets you add your own text and up to 4 images on top of someone else's post. Reply opens the post page where you write an answer. Share has Copy link and Share on X. Views count a unique viewer once per post.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/replies-reposts-quotes-rockets

### What can I follow, and on which chains?

You can follow any wallet and any coin, on any chain. Press Follow on a profile or a coin page. Their posts, reposts and coin updates then show in the Following tab on Home. You need a connected wallet to follow, but no extra signature. You can also follow a draft before the coin exists. Followers and following lists are on your profile, and tapping a count opens the list.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/follow-coins-and-wallets

### What notifications do I get, and can I turn them off?

The bell in the top bar shows the latest ones, and View all opens Command Center, then Notifications. You are notified about replies, quotes, reposts, rockets, mentions and follows, about battle challenges, about rewards ready to claim and about events on coins you created. Open Command Center, then Settings, then Notification settings. Each of the four categories has a Bell switch and an Email switch. Email works only after you add an address and open the link we send. Saving asks for a free wallet signature.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/notifications-and-email

### Do I have to sign every post, rocket or chat message?

No. The first time you post, reply or react, your wallet asks for one signature. It covers posts, replies, reposts, rockets, deleting your own posts, comments, War Room chat, reports, hide and block, and creator updates for 30 days. A signature is a message, not a transaction. It costs no gas, moves no funds and gives nobody access to your money. The message starts with MemeWarzone API Action. If a prompt asks you to approve a transaction or spend tokens when you only wanted to post, reject it. The signature is kept in this browser. On another browser or device, or with another wallet, you sign once more. Payments, claims, votes and challenges ask each time.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/sign-once-for-30-days

### Can I delete my own post?

Yes. Open the three dots menu on your own post or reply and choose Delete post or Delete reply. You are asked to confirm. A deleted post disappears from the feed, your profile and search. This cannot be undone. Copies others made elsewhere, such as a screenshot or a share on X, are not removed.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/delete-a-post

### How do I report, hide or block someone?

Every post, reply, comment and profile has a three dots menu. It offers Report, Hide for single posts and comments, and Block for accounts. Hide and Block only change what you see. Report goes to the team, who review every report. To report, describe what is wrong in 20 to 1,000 characters and press Send report. Follow your reports in Command Center, then Support and safety, then My Abuse Reports. To unblock someone, open Settings and use the Blocked accounts card. For impersonation or stolen identity, use File Abuse Report on the Support and safety page.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/report-hide-and-block

### What can other people see about my wallet?

Blockchains are public. Anyone can look up a wallet address in an explorer and see its balances and transactions. MemeWarzone cannot hide that. Your profile page shows the address, your coin holdings and your activity, such as launches and trades. You can shape the holdings lists in Command Center, then Settings, then Portfolio display. You can hide native coins and stablecoins and holdings under 1 dollar. These settings only change the lists, not your real balances or your total value. No account or email is needed to use MemeWarzone. Your wallet is your identity. MemeWarzone never asks for your seed phrase or private key.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/what-is-public-about-my-wallet

### What is the LIVE tab on a profile?

A profile can show a LIVE tab after Posts while its owner is streaming on Kick. The tab flashes red. It plays Kick's own player and chat. Right now this is only set up for one partner profile. Kick sets cookies when the player loads, so MemeWarzone asks for cookie consent before it plays. Declining keeps the player off and you can open the stream on kick.com.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/profile-live-tab

### What is the difference between comments and the War Room chat?

Every coin page has a Posts tab with the owner's updates, automatic updates and comments. The War Room is a live chat for that coin. Anyone can read both without a wallet. To post, connect and sign once. Prepare pages for drafts have comments instead of a live chat. Moderation removes obvious spam, phishing links and impersonation, but it cannot make every message safe.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/coin-comments-and-chat

### How are views on a post counted?

A view counts when a post is at least half on screen for about one second, or when you open its page. Each viewer counts once per post. A wallet that signed in for social actions counts once, and everyone else counts once per IP address. Opening the same post again does not add views.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/post-views-counted

### What do the tabs on Home show?

For you shows posts, reposts, creator updates, launches, graduations and battles, newest first. Following shows only wallets you follow, with chips for People, Coins and Auto updates. Launches, Battles and Graduations filter by type for the chain you picked. Posts with a Taking off label collected reactions fast in the last 48 hours. On phones the extra cards, such as Trending and League, move into tabs.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/home-feed-tabs

## Safety and security

### Will MemeWarzone ever ask for my seed phrase or private key?

No. MemeWarzone never asks for your seed phrase, recovery phrase or private key, in the app, in Discord, on X, in Telegram or by email. Anyone who asks is a scammer, even if they look like staff. A wallet only needs you to approve or sign a message or transaction. Signing does not require your seed phrase.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/never-share-seed-phrase

### What are the official MemeWarzone links and channels?

Use only these official places. Type the address yourself or use a bookmark. App: app.memewar.zone Website: memewar.zone Docs: docs.memewar.zone X: x.com/memewarzone Telegram: t.me/memewarzonehq Discord: discord.gg/aXTkn3Asu Email: support@memewar.zone

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/official-links-and-channels

### How do I spot a fake coin or an impersonator?

Anyone can launch a coin with any name, image and ticker. A matching name or logo does not prove the coin belongs to a project, a person or a company. Check the contract address against the one the project posts on its own official channels, and check which chain the coin is on. Look at who created the coin and how old it is. An UpVote, a Featured spot, a rising chart or a crowded page does not make a coin safe. Compare the full contract address, not only the name or ticker. Be careful with coins launched seconds after a famous name starts trending. Ignore DMs that point you to a coin or a claim page. If someone uses your name or images, file a Report Abuse case.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/spot-fake-coins-and-impersonation

### How do I report impersonation, stolen images or phishing?

Use File Abuse Report in the Command Center under Support and safety. Abuse reports are for identity problems: someone impersonating you, using your images or content, a fake project pretending to be you, or phishing that pretends to be you or MemeWarzone. You can also report a post, comment or profile from its menu. A failed trade or a missing reward is not abuse. Take those to Discord support. 1. Open Command Center, then Support and safety, and press File Abuse Report. 2. Pick a category and, if you know it, what you are reporting: a profile, coin, token, wallet, post or website. Add the link or address. 3. Describe what happened and how it targets you. 4. Enter your email and add evidence if you have it: JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF, up to 5 files of 10 MB each.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/report-abuse

### How will I hear back about my abuse report?

After you submit you get a case number and a link to the case. My Abuse Reports lists your cases with type, date, status and last update. Staff replies appear only there. You get an email when there is a reply, but do not answer the email. Reply inside the case, where you can also add more evidence. Only you and the abuse team can see your reports. Regular Discord support cannot.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/abuse-report-replies

### What does MemeWarzone control and what does it not?

MemeWarzone is non-custodial. It does not hold your coins, and fees are split inside the same transaction as the trade. You sign every transaction from your own wallet. The team does not control the market price of a coin, other people's trades or what a coin's creator does with their own tokens. The platform can improve structure and visibility, but it cannot remove market risk.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/what-memewarzone-controls

### Who owns the contracts, and are they audited?

On BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain the contracts are owned by a Safe multisig and cannot be changed after deployment. On Solana the programs can only be upgraded through a Squads multisig. An external audit is pending on every chain. Until it is done, treat the contracts as unaudited by an outside firm. Protocol earnings above a fixed cap move to a multisig wallet. The contract addresses are listed on the About page.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/contracts-owners-and-audit

### Can a creator rug a coin? What is locked after graduation?

When a coin graduates, its liquidity moves into a DEX pool and is locked for good. The creator cannot withdraw that liquidity. On BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain the pool is on Uniswap V4. On Solana it is on Meteora. That does not remove all risk. A creator can still sell the tokens they hold, and a coin can lose most of its value. The creator reserve is 2% of supply (20M tokens). On Solana it is released at graduation. On BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain it is released no earlier than 1 hour after graduation, and only while the price is at or above the graduation price.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/rug-risk-and-locked-liquidity

### What safety checks run on imported coins?

When you import a coin, MemeWarzone checks that the address is a real token on the chosen chain, that the coin has left its bonding stage and has a funded DEX pool, and that the token can be sold and moved freely. An import is refused when the address is not a token, selling fails (a honeypot), transfers are blocked or paused, or the transfer tax is above 10%. Some findings send the coin to review instead, and it is not listed until the review is done. Trading is switched off on a coin when a later scan reports a honeypot or a blocked transfer. A passed check lowers some risks. It is not a promise that a coin is safe.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/import-safety-checks

### What wallet prompts should make me stop and not sign?

Read every prompt before you approve. Stop if anything does not match what you meant to do. The website domain in the prompt is not an official one. The chain is not the one you chose. It asks for an approval of unlimited spending, or to give another address control of your tokens. It asks you to sign a message you cannot read, or a transaction you did not start. A message, DM or email says you must claim something urgently or your wallet will be locked. Someone offers support or recovery help that you did not ask for.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/phishing-signatures-to-watch

### What does MemeWarzone ask me to sign?

You sign once when you connect, and that sign-in covers social actions such as posts, follows and comments for 30 days. You also sign for actions that move money or change something on chain: buying, selling, creating a coin, buying Boosts or UpVotes, signing up as a recruiter and claiming rewards. A sign-in message is not a transaction and cannot move your coins. Still, read each prompt. If a prompt appears that you did not trigger, close it.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/what-memewarzone-asks-you-to-sign

### What information about me is public?

Blockchain data is public. Anyone can see your wallet address, your trades and your balances on a block explorer. Your MemeWarzone profile is tied to your wallet and is the same on every chain: picture, name, @username and bio. Posts, follows, comments and league and battle results are public. No account or email is needed to use the app. The email you give in an abuse report is used only to tell you when the report is updated, and only you and the abuse team see the report.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/what-data-is-public

### How do I keep my wallet and account secure?

Your wallet is your account, so its security is your security. MemeWarzone cannot reset a wallet, reverse a transaction or recover lost keys. Keep your seed phrase offline and never type it into a website or chat. Use a separate wallet for trading, with only the funds you are ready to risk. Consider a hardware wallet for larger balances. Bookmark the official app and do not follow links from DMs or replies. Check the domain, chain and action in each prompt before you sign. Review and revoke token approvals you no longer need. Do not use money you cannot afford to lose.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/account-security-tips

### How do I contact MemeWarzone support?

For product questions about wallets, trading, launches and rewards, use the MemeWarzone Discord. You can also write to support@memewar.zone. Legal questions go to legal@memewar.zone. Use Report Abuse in the Command Center for impersonation, stolen images or phishing. Support never asks for your seed phrase or private key and never asks you to send funds to get a reward.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/contact-support

### What are the risks of trading memecoins on MemeWarzone?

You can lose all the money you put into a memecoin. Prices are volatile and can change fast. Weak coins, bad timing, bad links, infrastructure delays and bad judgment can all cost money. MemeWarzone gives information and tools, not financial advice. Rewards are never guaranteed income. Use only money you can afford to lose. The service is operated under Dutch law and is for users aged 18 or older.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/memewarzone-risk-disclosure

## Troubleshooting

### Why did my buy or sell fail?

The usual reasons are: the price moved more than your slippage allows, you do not have enough of the chain's coin left for the network fee, the order is large and moves the price too much, or your wallet is on a different network than the coin. A new coin can also be not open for trading yet. A failed transaction can still cost the network fee. The trade panel and your wallet show the actual error. Do not report a failed trade as abuse. Abuse reports are for identity problems. 1. Try a smaller amount. 2. Keep some BNB, SOL or ETH in the wallet for the network fee. 3. Check that your wallet is on the coin's chain. 4. If the panel offers it, try again with slightly higher slippage.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/my-transaction-failed

### What does 'slippage exceeded' mean?

The price moved past your limit between the quote and the moment the trade ran, so the trade was stopped to protect you. It happens on fast coins, on large orders and in the first minute after a launch. Retry with a smaller amount. Where the panel has a slippage menu, as on BNB Chain, pick a higher value only if you accept a worse price. On Solana the limit is fixed at 5%.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/slippage-exceeded-error

### My wallet shows a warning on a trade. Is it a scam?

Not always. Wallets scan every transaction and show a warning for things they cannot recognize. New sites, new tokens and thin liquidity often trigger one. A warning is a reason to read, not proof of a scam and not proof of safety. Read what the wallet says it will do. A MemeWarzone trade sends your coin or token to the curve or pool and gives you the other side. It should never ask you to approve unlimited spending for unknown addresses or to share your seed phrase. If the request does not match what you pressed, reject it. If the site is brand new on a partner website that uses the swap box, Phantom can show a message that the domain is new or not reviewed. That comes from Phantom checking the website and usually goes away within days.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/wallet-shows-a-warning

### Why does Phantom show more instructions than I expected on Solana?

Phantom rewrites the transaction before you sign. It adds compute budget instructions and a Lighthouse safety check for each account the transaction writes. Lighthouse is Phantom's own guard. It checks that the accounts end up in the expected state and fails the transaction if not. So an app buy can show more instructions and a larger size in the wallet than the app built. That is normal. If the wallet shows an action you did not ask for, such as an unrelated transfer, reject it.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/extra-instructions-in-phantom

### My transaction is stuck on pending. What now?

Wait a few minutes. The network can be busy. Many wallets offer Speed up or Cancel on EVM chains. On Solana, a transaction that does not land within about a minute usually expires and no funds move. Before you try again, check your wallet history and the chain explorer. If the first one succeeded, a second one buys twice.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/transaction-stuck-pending

### My balance or position does not update after a trade.

Refresh the page. Then check that the right wallet is connected. Check your wallet history to see whether the transaction succeeded. If you added Robinhood Chain to your wallet through MemeWarzone before October 14, it may use an old RPC address that now fails often. MemeWarzone offers to switch your wallet to the public RPC. Accept it, or update the network in your wallet.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/balance-not-updating

### I cannot find a coin.

Coins and search show one chain at a time. Check the chain buttons first. Then search by ticker, name or the full address. Search finds coins launched or imported on MemeWarzone, people by display name or @username, and any wallet by its address. A draft or scheduled coin may not be open for trading yet. A coin that was launched elsewhere is not listed until someone imports it.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/cannot-find-a-coin

### The page shows the wrong chain or asks me to switch networks.

Coins, Leagues, the War Trade Room and search show one chain at a time. Use the chain buttons to pick BNB, Solana or Robinhood. Your choice is remembered. A coin page always opens on the coin's own chain. For a trade, your wallet must be on the coin's network. BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain use the same EVM address, so the wallet only needs to switch network. Solana needs a Solana wallet.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/page-shows-the-wrong-chain

### My wallet keeps asking me to sign.

One signature covers social actions for 30 days. It is kept in this browser. You sign again on another browser or device, with another wallet, or after the 30 days. Actions such as saving your profile, voting, payments and claims ask every time by design. If the same request returns again and again, check that you are using the same wallet account and that the browser keeps site data. Private windows and blocked site data cannot keep the signature. Reject any prompt that asks you to approve a transaction or spend tokens when you only wanted to post.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/signature-request-keeps-appearing

### Why does it say 'Boosts are closed'?

Boosts close when the last 20% of a battle's clock starts. A 24 hour battle closes Boosts at 19 hours 12 minutes. A 1 hour battle closes them at 48 minutes. After that you can no longer add a Boost to either side. Each wallet can also Boost only twice per battle, both sides together. Free votes are separate from Boosts.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/boosts-are-closed

### My UpVote does not show up.

Wait a minute and refresh the page. Then check your wallet history to see whether the payment went through. An UpVote counts after its transaction is confirmed. If the transaction failed, no vote was cast. A cooldown and daily limits apply to UpVotes. If the popup says you reached a limit, try later. Do not use links from strangers that claim to UpVote for you.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/upvote-not-counted

### I cannot find my claim button.

Claims live in Command Center, under Rewards and claims, for the wallet that earned them. Check that you have connected the right wallet and picked the right chain. League, airdrop, recruiter, battle and creator payouts are listed there once they are ready. A reward that is still Pending is not claimable yet. Prizes are not paid automatically to every holder and are not guaranteed. For an imported coin, creator earnings can only be claimed after you prove you own the coin.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/claim-button-missing

### Wallet will not connect on my phone.

A phone browser has no wallet inside the page. Tap your wallet in the connect window and MemeWarzone opens inside that wallet's own browser, ready to connect. You can also open the site from the browser inside the wallet app yourself. If the wallet does not open on a site you visit, try the wallet browser. Unlock the wallet first, then refresh.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/mobile-wallet-browser

### The app looks wrong or old. Should I clear my cache?

Start with a hard refresh. Then try another browser or a private window to see whether the problem is local. If a page works there, clear the site data for memewar.zone and connect again. Clearing site data removes the stored social signature and your cookie choice, so your wallet asks you to sign again. Your coins and profile live on the chain and on our servers. Clearing the cache does not touch them. Never share a seed phrase while troubleshooting.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/clear-cache-and-refresh

### A coin page says trading has not opened.

Drafts have a public Prepare page, but they do not trade. A scheduled launch can open trading up to 30 days after it is created. The page shows the countdown. Buying is not possible before then. In the first 60 seconds after trading opens, the fee starts at 90% and falls to 2%. Check the fee in the quote before you buy.

URL: https://app.memewar.zone/faq/coin-not-open-for-trading
